Bid Summary.value: Dallas ISD seeks to procure student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors, through this Request for Proposal (RFP). Vendors must have the ability to provide significant quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines. The District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors. Awarded vendors must provide computing devices that meet current industry standard specifications and include deployment services, white glove services, and warranty and warranty repair work.
